**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

**As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for complex software features from design through delivery. You set the technical direction, raise the bar on quality, and make the people around you better. You work with modern AI tools and have the opportunity to participate in great AI Hackathons organized together with Microsoft (check recap from recent event here AI Hackathon 2026 ).

As an Engineer in Service Orchestration you will be part of international team builidng reliable, scalable services, orchestrating workflows and integrations, and automating operational processes. We work on developing self-service tools that allow our stakeholders to deploy and manage cloud environments.

We develop backend (API) and frontend (web application) using mainly:

• C# .NET

• Angular

• Azure

This is a devops role requiring not only development skills but also participating in bug fixing, testing, investigating and supporting users with additional focus on security. Requires being engaged and taking initiative.

Engineers at SimCorp are expected to shape how the work gets done, not just execute what's handed to them. If you want to own something end to end and work alongside people who take the craft seriously, this is the right environment.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead the design and architecture of software solutions that meet both business needs and engineering standards, and be accountable for the outcome.

• Mentor and support engineers across the team. The expectation is that your involvement makes the team better, not just the code.

• Work closely with product and design to ensure seamless delivery from concept to production.

• Own the resolution of complex technical issues. You are the person others escalate to, and you are expected to have an answer or find one.

• Drive continuous improvement in how the team builds software: tooling, processes, standards, and culture. If something is slowing the team down, you fix it or propose how to fix it.

• Set the standard for code quality. Code reviews are how you scale your judgment across the team.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading technically complex projects.

• Solid foundation in software design, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.

• The ability to communicate clearly across disciplines, with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders alike.

• A bias toward action and ownership, and low tolerance for unnecessary complexity.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have dedicated time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Do you want to help turn operational data into reliable insights that support the safe and efficient operation of our wind assets? We’re looking for an OT O&M Manager for Information & Data to lead the services that make critical operational information available, reliable and ready to support better decisions across Business Area Wind.

Reliable operational information and data are essential for running and managing Business Area Wind’s assets. They enable operational decision-making, performance monitoring, reporting, engineering and the exchange of information with internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for an OT O&M (Operation and Maintenance) Manager for Information & Data within the OT team in Business Area Wind. This is an operational management role with end-to-end accountability for the performance, availability, reliability and continuous improvement of this business-critical service area.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every information and data domain. You do, however, need a strong understanding of OT environments and data-driven services and the ability to lead technical teams, challenge and support specialists, set priorities, make decisions and ensure that issues are driven through to resolution.

For this role, leadership, Accountability and Proactivity are as important as technical understanding. You will create the structure and momentum needed to deliver reliable information and data services.

The OT Information & Data service area is responsible for making operational data and digital asset information available, reliable and usable across Business Area Wind. The service area connects local assets, fleet operations and enterprise consumers while supporting controlled information exchange with external authorities and joint-venture partners.

The scope includes operational data provisioning and integration, data quality management, enterprise engineering services, operational reporting, advanced data-driven solutions and lifecycle management of OT information and data.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take end-to-end ownership of the OT Information & Data service area and ensure that operational data and digital asset information remain available, reliable and usable for teams across Business Area Wind. You will set clear priorities for the service area, lead and develop service managers, engineers and domain experts, and create the governance needed to manage performance, risks, costs and dependencies. A key part of the role is to shape the service strategy and roadmap, balancing stable day-to-day delivery with lifecycle needs and the operationalisation of new data-driven solutions. Working across OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects and suppliers, you will bring the right expertise together, resolve issues and ensure improvements are followed through to completion.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

• Take end-to-end accountability for the OT Information & Data service area, including its performance, availability, reliability, cost and continuous improvement.

• Lead and develop the service area team, setting clear priorities and expectations while empowering service managers, engineers and domain experts to deliver within their areas of expertise.

• Drive operational performance, ensuring service risks, data-quality issues, dependencies and improvement needs are proactively identified, prioritised and followed through to resolution.

• Own the service strategy and roadmap, including priorities, budget, resources, lifecycle needs and the development of information and data services in line with Business Area Wind’s operational requirements.

• Manage the OT Information & Data service portfolio, ensuring reliable standard services while enabling new and advanced data-driven solutions to be operationalised and scaled.

• Provide effective operational governance, using service performance, risks, KPIs and expert input to make decisions, manage priorities and ensure clear accountability.

• Manage stakeholders and interfaces across Business Area Wind, bringing together data and analytics, OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects, suppliers and business stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver results.

• Drive continuous improvement in services, processes, data quality and ways of working, ensuring OT Information & Data remains reliable and fit for future business needs.

Your profile / who are you?

You combine a solid understanding of OT information and data environments with leadership experience from complex operational settings. You are comfortable taking Accountability for a broad service area without needing to be the technical expert in every domain. Instead, you create clarity, set priorities and empower specialists to deliver within their areas of expertise. With Proactivity, Collaboration, Composure and a Solution-Oriented approach, you use performance information, risks and expert input to make informed decisions and keep topics moving. You build strong relationships across technical teams, business functions and suppliers, and you are motivated by improving service reliability, data quality and ways of working over time.

Next to this you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational management, O&M, IT/OT service management, information and data management, engineering management or asset management, preferably within energy or another asset-intensive industry.

• Experience leading technical teams or services in a complex operational environment, with a track record of improving performance and driving issues through to resolution.

• A good understanding of OT information and data environments, sufficient to lead specialists, understand risks and dependencies, challenge recommendations and make informed decisions.

• Strong service-management capabilities, including operational performance, governance, risk management, lifecycle planning and continuous improvement.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, suppliers and management.

• A relevant degree in engineering, technology, information or data management, business or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands - Kolding, Denmark

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact hiring manager Hasan Özdem, hasan.oezdem@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 03.12.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, Validata.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Where there’s you, there’s a way.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Head of Group FP&A

At Salling Group, we are on an ambitious growth journey. As we continue to grow across markets, formats and businesses, the ability to connect performance, investments and strategic priorities becomes increasingly important.

We are looking for a Head of Group FP&A to lead and further develop our Group-wide financial planning and performance management agenda. This is one of the most impactful leadership roles in Finance, offering a unique opportunity to shape how financial insights support decisions, prioritization and long-term value creation across the Group.

The role

As Head of Group FP&A, you will lead a strong team and play a key role in strengthening how we understand, plan and improve business performance across Salling Group. You will help create a more connected view of performance, ensuring that financial and operational insights are translated into actions that make a difference.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be part of the Finance Leadership Team and our Global Finance Board. In close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our organization, you will help shape decisions related to performance, investments, growth opportunities and resource allocation.

This role is about much more than reporting and budgeting. It is about challenging assumptions, identifying opportunities, developing future finance talent and helping the business navigate an increasingly dynamic environment.

**

What you will be responsible for**

You will play a central role in:

• Driving Group-wide performance management, ensuring transparent and relevant insights that support better business decisions across markets and formats.

• Further developing our planning, budgeting and forecasting approach to create greater alignment between financial targets, business priorities and investments.

• Leading the Group's capital allocation and investment governance processes, helping prioritize opportunities and create transparency around value creation.

• Strengthening the focus on working capital and cash performance through clear governance, follow-up and business engagement.

• Supporting strategic initiatives, business cases, acquisitions and integration activities through robust financial analysis and performance insights.

• Developing a high-performing FP&A team while helping build the next generation of finance leaders across Salling Group, including ownership of our Finance Graduate Programme.

**

Your profile**

You are an experienced finance leader who combines analytical strength with commercial understanding and the ability to create followership across a complex organization. Experience from retail, FMCG or similarly operational businesses is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We imagine that you:

• Have a strong track record of driving performance management and planning processes in a complex organization.

• Understand how financial results are created through commercial and operational decisions.

• Are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and challenging established thinking when needed.

• Have experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

• Enjoy building talent and creating opportunities for others to grow.

• Combine curiosity, pragmatism and business judgement with a strong drive to create impact.

**

What we offer**

• A key leadership role at the center of one of the Nordic region's largest retail groups.

• The opportunity to work closely with executive management on some of the most important decisions across the business.

• Significant influence on how performance management, planning and investment decisions evolve across the Group.

• The chance to lead a strong team and help develop future finance leaders.

• A collaborative and ambitious culture where people support each other and enjoy working together.

**

Are you curious?**

If you have any questions about the position you can contact Group CFO, Thomas Børglum Jensen +4521210166 or Senior People & Culture Business Partner, Louise Lærke on +45 28296362.

Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible as we reserve the right to remove the job advert when we have found the right candidate.

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark. Travelling will be expected.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Salling Group

Salling Group is one of the largest retailers in the Nordics, with approximately 70,000 employees and more than 2,100 stores across six European countries. Through our Aspire '28 strategy, we have set an ambitious direction for continued growth and development. Owned by the Salling Foundations, our profits are either reinvested in the business or donated to charitable causes. We are driven by a simple ambition: making everyday life better for our customers.

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Build collaboration software at scale. Solve complex engineering problems. Help shape how we develop software at Dalux.

**At Dalux, we build software used by construction professionals in more than 140 countries. Our Box product helps people across construction projects manage, share, review, and collaborate on files and information.

We are looking for an experienced software developer to join our Box Collab team, where you will work on functionality that is widely used and deeply integrated into the Dalux platform.

This is an opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, improve an established product and architecture, and influence how we increasingly use AI to make software development more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer in Box Collab, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a skilled full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. Together, you will develop functionality that supports collaboration between construction stakeholders, including file sharing, commenting, versioning, and review workflows.

Our developers do more than implement specifications. We expect experienced engineers to understand the problems we are solving, contribute to technical decisions, challenge existing solutions, and help raise the engineering standards around them.

Your work will include:

• Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable full-stack solutions.

• Improving database performance through query optimization, indexing strategies, and thoughtful data design.

• Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of Box Collab.

• Improving the structure and modularity of an established codebase while reducing technical debt.

• Taking ownership of complex functionality from design through implementation, testing, and delivery.

• Mentoring and sparring with other developers through technical discussions and code reviews.

• Identifying opportunities to improve our development tools, engineering practices, and ways of working.

You will have room to influence both what we build and how we build it.

**Developing software with AI

**We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted software development across Dalux.

We are exploring how AI can improve the entire development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and navigating complex codebases to designing solutions, implementing functionality, writing tests, reviewing code, debugging, and refactoring.

The Box Collab team is already experimenting with AI-assisted development, and we want experienced developers who can help take these practices further.

For us, this is not simply about generating code faster. It is about understanding where AI can meaningfully improve engineering effectiveness while maintaining strong standards for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

As an experienced developer, we expect you to:

• Explore and apply AI-assisted development workflows in your daily engineering work.

• Use your engineering judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions and their trade-offs.

• Identify opportunities where AI can help improve complex existing systems and development processes.

• Share successful practices and contribute to how AI-assisted development evolves across Dalux.

Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic development is a strong advantage. More importantly, we are looking for engineers who combine curiosity about new approaches with the ability to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.

**Technologies we work with

**Box Collab is a full-stack product area primarily using:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• Microsoft SQL Server

• Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Your background

**We are looking for an experienced software developer who enjoys taking responsibility beyond individual development tasks.

We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience and a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals and are comfortable working in established codebases.

• Can independently investigate complex problems and make well-reasoned technical decisions.

• Care about performance, maintainability, reliability, and software quality.

• Enjoy technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and helping other developers improve.

• Are interested in challenging existing approaches and exploring how AI can improve software engineering.

For this particular team, we would especially value experience with:

• C# and .NET development.

• Relational databases, query performance, and indexing strategies.

• Modernizing or improving established software systems.

• Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to managing software complexity.

• AI-assisted development tools and workflows.

You do not need to match every point. Technical judgment, learning ability, and the motivation to improve complex software are more important than experience with a particular framework or architectural pattern.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**At Dalux, software development is central to how we create value.

As part of Box Collab, you can expect:

• Meaningful technical ownership: Influence both product functionality and the architecture behind it.

• Challenging engineering problems: Work with performance, data, integration, and long-term maintainability in a widely used product.

• Strong technical colleagues: Join a collaborative team where developers share knowledge, challenge ideas, and take responsibility for outcomes.

• Close product collaboration: Work directly with Product Management and Design to understand problems and shape solutions.

• Influence on AI-assisted development: Help establish new workflows and engineering practices as we evolve how software is built.

• Professional growth: Opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on greater responsibility.

• Sustainable working practices: A healthy work-life balance and a culture that values sustainable performance over overwork.

We have a flat organization with short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation, and a high degree of trust in how our developers solve problems.

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen, where collaboration, technical sparring, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Our products are used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the engineering behind them.

**Interested?

**If you want to work on complex software with significant technical responsibility, help evolve an established product, and contribute to how AI is changing software engineering at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

We recruit on an ongoing basis as Dalux continues to grow.

Experience building and operating production platforms at scale? Help shape the data platform behind energy trading through technical leadership, architectural influence and mentoring fellow engineers

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, your primary function will be to design, build and run critical parts of our internal data platform. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will influence the team's design decisions, challenge existing approaches, set the bar for engineering quality and mentor colleagues. As the platform is being modernized now, your work will have broad influence on its development and direct impact on our trading activities.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• designing and building core platform capabilities across cloud data infrastructure, .NET and streaming platforms that enable data to move through the business, or across our machine-learning platform and feature store

• making the platform reliable and observable on performance, capacity, cost, monitoring and incident follow-up

• reviewing and challenging architecture and design decisions, bringing in practices from outside Danske Commodities

• mentoring engineers in the team and helping newer colleagues get productive quickly

• building self-service 'golden paths' so other teams can build on the platform without waiting for us

You join a team building the data platform every data engineer and quant at Danske Commodities works on - early enough to shape its architecture, with a mandate to challenge how we do things today. (Erik Hjælm Skole, Head of Data Platform Engineering)

Meet your team

You will join our Data Platform Infrastructure team, where we build and run the shared platform capabilities that Danske Commodities builds on. Our primary responsibilities include compute platforms, streaming infrastructure, the data ingestion framework, machine learning infrastructure and hosted data tooling. We make it fast and safe for other teams to build with data by providing the platform capabilities they rely on.

We are a newly formed team of four experienced engineers, growing to nine team members. Our backgrounds are currently within software engineering, cloud infrastructure and data-science platforms. We work with Python, C#/.NET and Rust, test-driven and with a strong focus on automation. We always seek to build things our users want to use, not just things they have to use.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be influencing the direction of our data platform and the way we build software, we imagine that you are solution-oriented and see opportunities where others see problems. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvement and constructively challenging existing approaches when needed. At the same time, you are motivated by helping others succeed and sharing your knowledge with fellow engineers.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• hold a relevant educational background within computer science, software engineering or similar – or equivalent practical experience

• have a minimum of 8 years’ experience as a software engineer building and operation production systems

• are proficient in C#/.NET and Python

• have deep hands-on experience with cloud, containers, infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g. Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions)

• are proficient in English - both written and spoken

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

We offer

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
jobs.description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
Your Role
As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
• Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
• Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
• Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
• Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
• Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
• Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
• Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
• Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
• Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
• Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.Commercial and Customer Support
• Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
• Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
• Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
• Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.Product Lifecycle Management
• Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
• Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
• Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
• Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.Your Profile
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

• A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
• Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
• A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
• Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
• The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
• A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
• Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
• Good written and spoken English.
Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.
What We Offer
• A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
• The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
• Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
• An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
• Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
• An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
• Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.
The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.
Apply Now
Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

Are you a hands-on, security focused engineer ready to help build a technical security foundation? If you thrive on turning compliance frameworks into real-world technical control while staying closely connected to daily operations, this job is for you.

Working closely with our Head of IT and Security, you will turn our ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, and the EU AI Act) into operating technical reality by designing, implementing, and operating the controls, tooling, and secure configurations that protect Space Inventor across our Corporate, Missions, and SatOPS zones. This is a role focused on establishing new capabilities rather than maintaining an existing setup. Alongside hands-on security engineering, you will co-own and deliver day-to-day IT support, keeping you grounded in user needs and the operational reality of our environment.

Given Space Inventors work you must be eligible for a Danish Personnel Security Clearance.

The job is located in Aalborg, Denmark.

Your Responsibilities

• Core Security & Tooling: Design, implement, and operate core security controls and tooling (EDR, logging/SIEM, vulnerability management, email, and endpoint security).

• Identity & Access Management: Build and harden the identity foundation (Entra ID security, MFA, Conditional Access, PAM, Windows LAPS, and access governance).

• Hardening & Infrastructure: Establish endpoint and server hardening baselines (CIS benchmarks) enforced via Intune; support secure design for infrastructure rebuilds and Entra ID/M365 migrations.

• Network & Zone Security: Implement network security and segmentation across our three zones (Corporate, Missions, SatOPS), including the overlay for OT and the SatOPS ground segment.

• Vulnerability Management & Incident Response: Scan, prioritize, remediate, and verify vulnerabilities; build detection, alerting, playbooks, and hands-on investigation/recovery.

• Automation & Architecture: Automate security operations via PowerShell/scripting; contribute to technical roadmaps, document controls, and serve as a technical security resource.

• Compliance & Governance: Implement technical controls behind the Statement of Applicability and produce evidence for ISO 27001 certification and NIS2 compliance.

• IT Operations & Support: Co-own and deliver day-to-day service desk support, troubleshooting endpoint/user issues, Microsoft 365, onboarding/offboarding, and hardware/AV lifecycles.

Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in IT security engineering or SecOps specifically building or maturing controls from scratch combined with solid IT support experience. Experience from regulated, manufacturing, critical-infrastructure, or OT environments is an advantage (space experience is not required).

Technical Proficiencies:

• Hands-on security engineering across endpoints, identity, cloud, and networks.

• Microsoft security stack: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, M365 security, Defender (EDR), and ideally Sentinel or a comparable SIEM.

• Hardening baselines (CIS), patch management, and vulnerability scanning.

• Network security: Firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, and traffic monitoring.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell.

• Incident response, triage, and log analysis.

Standards & Compliance: Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2 requirements; awareness of OT / IEC 62443 is a strong plus.

Education & Certifications: Degree in IT/cybersecurity or equivalent proven experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-200/AZ-500/SC-100, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH) are an advantage.

Personal Attributes: A builder mindset with strong initiative; pragmatic and risk-oriented; structured with audit-ready documentation; and a clear, discreet communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

**

• A strong track record of mentoring engineers, leading cross-team projects, and driving design and technology decisions at a senior or lead level

• The ability to align technical execution with product and design partners, with a strong bias to ship and iterate

• Deep experience with object-oriented programming languages; we mostly use Java and typescript but appreciate a variety of languages!

• A strong technical background with extensive experience working directly on complex backend and/or frontend systems and projects, including in leadership or lead engineer roles

• Great pride from taking ownership of product ideas from inception through to production

• Good understanding of both frontend and backend best practices and paradigms.

• Integrated AI impactfully in customer-facing products or engineering infrastructure

**You Might Also Have

**

• Experience with AI-friendly and driven systems

• Exposure to or interest in the cryptocurrency technology ecosystem

• Terraform and Kubernetes knowledge

**Technologies We Use

**

• Java (Spring Boot)

• Typescript (React, Angular)

• Kafka (Warpstream)

• K8S

• Terraform

• PostgreSQL

**AI at Chainalysis

**AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. The site will build core capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of integrated antenna and RF front-end subsystems for high-performance direction finding systems in ELINT applications. The work will cover system and RF architecture, UWB antenna systems, RF receiver front-end hardware, OTA characterization and calibration, mechanical integration, and preparation for production and field deployment. Initial developments will target ground and airborne platforms, with the same core technologies later evolving toward aerospace and satellite applications.

jobs.description:
Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, is looking for a full-time Data manager to work at the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures (Land-CRAFT).

Land-CRAFT addresses three of our major societal challenges - food security, climate change, and loss of biodiversity. With Center partners from University of Copenhagen, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (Germany), and Colorado State University (USA), we bring together expertise in climate impact research, landscape analyses, biogeochemistry, agronomy, biology, and geography to develop solution – oriented research that extends across multiple spatial and temporal scales. Established in June 2022, Land-CRAFT has built a dynamic team to undertake both fundamental and applied research aimed to reduce the environmental impact of agricultural systems, specifically regarding greenhouse gas emissions. To reach our goals, we are using a combination of empirical, field-based approaches, digital technologies, including modelling and remote sensing, while closely interacting with stakeholders. The position we advertise here is aimed at supporting these activities with respect to data management. The new employee will become part of a support team with complementary skills and work collaboratively in an active and international research environment with diverse projects and people across Department of Agroecology.

The position is available from 1st March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The duration of the position is 3 years.

Responsibilities and tasks
Your main role as part of the support team at Land-CRAFT will be to support research activities of the staff and research students (at BSc, MSc, and PhD levels) in data management, analysis and statistics. This will include maintaining and supplementing relational databases used for process-based modelling and geospatial data analyses. Main responsibilities and tasks include:

• 
Organize, archive, and document data collected by the Land-CRAFT team, including with appropriate metadata protocols

• 
Manage data transfer/sharing among Center partners and external collaborators following FAIR data principles, AU rules and regulations, and GDPR rules

• 
Manage user access and permissions within the AU File system and user data on a computational server

• 
Create and manage a database on research outputs from the Center, including e.g., publications, citations and other reports, to facilitate website updates, annual reports, and other communication platforms, as well as managing the Zenodo community

• 
Support staff and students with statistical and geospatial analyses (e.g. in R and Python)

• 
Support/manage data collection pipeline from instruments in the lab & field (including visualisation of data in e.g. Origin)

• 
Establish, maintain, and refine documentation regarding all data-related protocols (e.g. data policy, data management plans, etc.)

• 
Coordinating data management across the Department of Agroecology (about 20 % of time) in collaboration with the department’s data steward

Your profile
As a member of the Land-Craft support team, we expect you to plan and perform your tasks independently and initiate frequent feedback and communication with Land CRAFT researchers and students. The position requires that you can communicate with and support students and scientists from BSc to Professor levels, including attention to detail and quality (QA/QC) and an affinity for knowledge-sharing, e.g., in working with students as they learn to manage their own data. You have a high proficiency in English, are culturally sensitive, and can work in a large group of diverse colleagues and students. At Land-CRAFT we emphasize good relationships among colleagues and students. It is therefore important that you have a positive and open personality, stay engaged with emerging challenges and opportunities, and are ready to support colleagues when needed.

Qualifications

• 
MSc in data science, agroecology, geoscience, biology, ecology, environmental science, mathematics, geography (or related fields)

• 
Knowledge and understanding of data management plans, metadata systems, archiving practices

• 
Experience in statistical analysis; knowledge of R or Python, as well as visualisation platforms

•
